title: Evidence package (stage 2)
description: The cite-able universe the script may draw from, plus the publishability decision. Anything the script later asserts must trace back to a key_fact or numeric_fact here. status='insufficient' ends the flow at stage 2.

consumed_by: stage 3 — the only facts the script may cite; trailing <!-- src: --> comments resolve to ids here
stage 4 — module evidence_ref values must come from key_facts or numeric_facts source_ids
stage 5 — C2 verifies <!-- src: --> ids resolve here; C3 enforces single-source attribution; C21 verifies numeric_fact_ref resolves
stage 7 — quote modules render only for quotes verbatim from this artifact
stage 8 — failure-class entries trace back to fields here when the failure is sourcing/*

status.description: Publishability gate. 'ok' continues to stage 3. 'insufficient' stops the flow; the runner writes _blockers.md and produces only stage 8.

reason.description: Required when status='insufficient'. One-paragraph explanation of which gate fired and which field on story.row triggered it.

key_facts.description: Short declarative facts the script may assert. Each cites at least one source_id. Aim for 5–10 entries.

text.description: One short declarative — no compound sentences with 'and'.

source_ids.description: Ids from story.row.source_documents[] that carry this fact. At least one.

entity_ids.description: Optional links to ids in story.row.primary_entities_enriched.

numeric_facts.description: Every figure the script may say. Pulled from story.row.structured_numbers first; verified against source documents.

id.description: Stable short id (e.g. 'fed_rate', 'casualty_total'). Referenced by module-plan numeric_fact_ref.

value.description: Exact value from the source. Do not round unless the rounded value is also present as a separate entry with context='rounded for narration'.

as_of.description: ISO date or session reference. Mandatory.

source_ids.description: Sources carrying this exact value. Single-source numbers trigger the stage-5 attribution rule.

context.description: Optional comparator window or qualifier ('single-day move', 'YTD', 'rounded for narration').

quotes.description: Verbatim quotes only. Empty array is fine. A paraphrase rendered here as a quote is a sourcing/paraphrase failure (playbook §2).

factual_conflicts.description: Mirror of story.row.factual_conflicts in the schema's shape. Conflicts surface; they are never resolved by picking a side.

topic.description: Short label for the conflict ('casualty count', 'settlement amount').

positions.description: At least two positions, each with the claim and its supporting source_ids.

source_diversity.description: Mirror of story.row.source_diversity_score and source_diversity_label, or null on pre-migration rows.

score.description: Numeric diversity score from the synthesizer.

label.description: Bucketed label. EvidenceShelf copy varies by bucket.

allOf.description: When status='insufficient', the reason field is mandatory.
When status='ok', the script-feeding fields are mandatory.
